items.h: Maui affordable housing manager Laura Valenzuela appointed to the Hawaiʻi State Ethics Commission
items.m: Gov. Josh Green appointed Maui affordable housing manager Laura Valenzuela to the Hawaiʻi State Ethics Commission on Friday. The governor also selected five other community leaders for state oversight roles, including seats on the Hawaiian Homes and Campaign Spending commissions.

items.h: Hawaiʻi DOH confirms fourth case of cyclosporiasis
